# Set knitting options for clean output
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo    = TRUE,    # show code
  message = FALSE,   # suppress messages
  warning = FALSE    # suppress warnings
)

# Load core libraries for data processing, HTTP requests, XML parsing and logging

```{r}
# Define folder containing .rds files for retry processing
step_2_input_folder <- "/Users/zorbeyozcan/newsmedia_scraper/working_data/urlset_scraper_output"

# Enumerate all .rds files in the input folder
step_2_input_files <- list.files(
  path      = step_2_input_folder,
  pattern   = "\\.rds$",
  full.names = TRUE
)

# Build a table of file paths and corresponding object names
step_2_input_files_df <- data.table(
  file_path   = step_2_input_files,
  object_name = basename(step_2_input_files) %>% str_remove("\\.rds$")
)

# Load each .rds file into the global environment under its original object name
for (i in seq_len(nrow(step_2_input_files_df))) {
  fp  <- step_2_input_files_df$file_path[i]
  nm  <- step_2_input_files_df$object_name[i]
  obj <- readRDS(fp)
  assign(nm, obj, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}
```

```{r}
# For each entry in the retry master table, create an empty retry response log
if (exists("global_retry_master_dt", envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(global_retry_master_dt))) {
    # Identify the sitemap layer ID
    step_5_layer_id <- global_retry_master_dt$layer_1_url_id[i]
    
    # Construct original and retry log table names
    step_5_orig_log_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", step_5_layer_id, "_response_log_dt")
    step_5_retry_log_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", step_5_layer_id, "_retry_response_log_dt")
    
    # If the original response log exists, derive its schema
    if (exists(step_5_orig_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
      step_5_orig_log_df  <- get(step_5_orig_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
      # Initialize zero-row copy for retry logs
      step_5_retry_log_df <- step_5_orig_log_df[0]
      # Assign the empty retry log table
      assign(step_5_retry_log_name, step_5_retry_log_df, envir = .GlobalEnv)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Initialize comparison results table
step_7_comparison_df <- data.table(
  domain_id               = integer(),
  domain_url              = character(),
  layer_1_url_id          = integer(),
  layer_1_url             = character(),
  links_with_error_before = integer(),
  links_with_error_after  = integer(),
  links_with_same_error   = integer(),
  processed_links         = integer()
)

# Iterate over each sitemap in the retry master
for (i in seq_len(nrow(global_retry_master_dt))) {
  # Extract identifiers
  step_7_layer_id  <- global_retry_master_dt$layer_1_url_id[i]
  step_7_domain_id <- global_retry_master_dt$domain_id[i]
  step_7_domain_url<- global_retry_master_dt$domain_url[i]
  step_7_layer_url <- global_retry_master_dt$layer_1_url[i]
  
  # Original and retry log names
  step_7_orig_log_name  <- paste0("sitemap_id_", step_7_layer_id, "_response_log_dt")
  step_7_retry_log_name <- paste0("sitemap_id_", step_7_layer_id, "_retry_response_log_dt")
  
  # Skip if retry log does not exist
  if (!exists(step_7_orig_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv) ||
      !exists(step_7_retry_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)) {
    next
  }
  
  # Load logs
  step_7_orig_log_dt  <- get(step_7_orig_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  step_7_retry_log_dt <- get(step_7_retry_log_name, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # Count links with retry_flag == TRUE
  step_7_links_with_error_before <- nrow(step_7_orig_log_dt[retry_flag == TRUE])
  step_7_links_with_error_after  <- nrow(step_7_retry_log_dt[retry_flag == TRUE])
  
  # Count same errors: join on requested_url, status code and message
  step_7_merged_dt <- merge(
    step_7_orig_log_dt[retry_flag == TRUE, .(requested_url, http_status_code, http_status_message)],
    step_7_retry_log_dt[retry_flag == TRUE, .(requested_url, http_status_code, http_status_message)],
    by = c("requested_url", "http_status_code", "http_status_message")
  )
  step_7_links_with_same_error <- nrow(unique(step_7_merged_dt))
  
  # Calculate processed links difference
  step_7_processed_links <- step_7_links_with_error_before - step_7_links_with_error_after
  
  # Append to comparison table
  step_7_comparison_df <- rbind(
    step_7_comparison_df,
    data.table(
      domain_id               = step_7_domain_id,
      domain_url              = step_7_domain_url,
      layer_1_url_id          = step_7_layer_id,
      layer_1_url             = step_7_layer_url,
      links_with_error_before = step_7_links_with_error_before,
      links_with_error_after  = step_7_links_with_error_after,
      links_with_same_error   = step_7_links_with_same_error,
      processed_links         = step_7_processed_links
    ),
    fill = TRUE
  )
}
```



```{r}

# Initialize an empty table for all extracted links and dates
step_8_results_dt_all_links <- data.table(
  domain_id        = integer(),
  domain_url       = character(),
  layer_1_url_id   = integer(),
  layer_1_url      = character(),
  urlset_url       = character(),
  result_link      = character(),
  date             = as.Date(character())
)

# Identify all output data tables in the environment
step_8_output_names <- ls(envir = .GlobalEnv, pattern = "^sitemap_id_[0-9]+_output_dt$")

# Iterate over each output table to extract <loc> and <lastmod> entries
for (nm in step_8_output_names) {
  step_8_out_dt <- get(nm, envir = .GlobalEnv)
  
  # Loop through each record in the output table
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(step_8_out_dt))) {
    step_8_xml_raw <- step_8_out_dt$urlset_content[i]
    # Skip empty or missing content
    if (is.na(step_8_xml_raw) || !nzchar(step_8_xml_raw)) next
    
    # Parse XML document
    step_8_doc <- tryCatch(read_xml(step_8_xml_raw), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(step_8_doc)) next
    
    # Rename default namespace to 'ns'
    step_8_ns <- xml_ns_rename(xml_ns(step_8_doc), d1 = "ns")
    # Extract all <loc> and <lastmod> elements
    step_8_loc_nodes     <- xml_find_all(step_8_doc, ".//ns:loc", ns = step_8_ns)
    step_8_lastmod_nodes <- xml_find_all(step_8_doc, ".//ns:lastmod", ns = step_8_ns)
    
    # Convert node sets to character vectors
    step_8_links    <- xml_text(step_8_loc_nodes)
    step_8_mods_raw <- xml_text(step_8_lastmod_nodes)
    
    # Clean and parse dates from <lastmod>
    step_8_mods_clean <- gsub("T.*", "", step_8_mods_raw)
    step_8_mods_clean[!str_detect(step_8_mods_clean, "^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$")] <- NA_character_
    step_8_mods_final <- as.Date(step_8_mods_clean, format = "%Y-%m-%d")
    
    # Ensure length alignment between links and dates
    step_8_mods_final <- rep(step_8_mods_final, length.out = length(step_8_links))
    
    # Keep only http/https links
    step_8_keep_idx <- which(str_detect(step_8_links, "^https?://"))
    if (length(step_8_keep_idx) == 0L) next
    
    # Assemble a temporary data.table for this urlset
    step_8_tmp_dt <- data.table(
      domain_id        = step_8_out_dt$domain_id[i],
      domain_url       = step_8_out_dt$domain_url[i],
      layer_1_url_id   = step_8_out_dt$layer_1_url_id[i],
      layer_1_url      = step_8_out_dt$layer_1_url[i],
      urlset_url       = step_8_out_dt$urlset_url[i],
      result_link      = step_8_links[step_8_keep_idx],
      date             = step_8_mods_final[step_8_keep_idx]
    )
    
    # Append to the master results table
    step_8_results_dt_all_links <- rbind(
      step_8_results_dt_all_links,
      step_8_tmp_dt,
      fill = TRUE
    )
  }
}

```
